verdict: Maybe, for a hardware team. Arista Vault pitched follow-me suitcases on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal. Smart luggage is eye-catching, but airline battery rules and high prices limit the market.
angle: Luggage with tracking, locks and self-driving features appeals to frequent travellers. Batteries must meet airline rules, usually by being removable. Durability and after-sales service decide reviews.
